scenes.description: The view centers on a refrigerator against the wall, with a cabinet nearby and a door set into its frame off to the side. Down on the floor, two trash cans sit close together, with the smaller one stacked on the larger.

A door and its frame dominate the view, with a cabinet sitting right beside them against the wall. Through the opening you can catch a glimpse of a toilet tucked back behind the wall, with plain walls and a bare floor filling out the scene.

You’re looking at a small bathroom-like corner with a toilet partly tucked behind a doorframe, and a window sitting higher up on the right wall. On the left wall, a cabinet hangs near the doorway, with plain walls and floor filling most of the view.

The view is mostly a cluster of armchairs on the floor, with one chair awkwardly stacked on top of another so it feels a bit cluttered. A column sits close by, tucked beside the chairs and looking small next to them.
